config.budget_selection: Largest1024-update multiple fitting remaining time after180s admission allowance, using p95 update time*1.05 plus6s per checkpoint/evaluation and300s fixed overhead; selected solely from measured costs, not quality.
config.optimizer_schedule: Unchanged autoresearch_train.fixed_schedule(total_updates): lr multiplier min(1,2*(1-i/N)), momentum .85+.1*min(i/300,1), muon weight decay .2*(1-i/N). Only N extended; formula/family/coefficient values unchanged.
differences: Extended total token/update budget and resulting horizon of original budget-relative optimizer schedule
Incremental exact-equivalent cyclic microbatch materialization instead of a full in-memory tape
Fixed validation/sample/checkpoint cadence and logging including unclipped gradient norm
Full-state resumable checkpoints, latest+predecessor+3milestones+best-validation retention; no test-based selection
config.frozen_test_policy: Once after training, final fixed-budget checkpoint only; previous campaign already opened this test set, so it is not pristine external evidence
config.interpretation: Deliberately repeated closed-pool baseline. One corpus pass has11378155positions including2263BOS; these are token positions in deduplicated documents, not distinct vocabulary types. No new data or reshuffle policy. Repetition and overfitting must be measured, not hidden.

scope: Single fixed-seed closed-pool reference; no statistical superiority claim
